The Notifier FST-951H-IV is an ivory, low-profile intelligent thermal detector with a fixed 190°F (88°C) alarm point, part of Notifier's FST-951 Series and a direct replacement for the FST-851 Series. It reports to FlashScan and CLIP protocol systems over the signaling line circuit (SLC). It is intended for property protection.

Key Features

  • High-temperature model factory preset to 190°F (88°C)
  • Thermistor sensing technology for fast response
  • Rotary decimal switches set the point ID address
  • Two LEDs with a 360° viewing angle: they blink red in normal condition and turn steady red in alarm
  • Functional test switch operated by an external magnet, plus remote test from the panel and walk test with address display
  • Plugs into a separate base, so photoelectric, ionization and thermal heads can be swapped on the same base

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Notifier (Honeywell)
  • Part Number: FST-951H-IV
  • Color: Ivory
  • Protocol: FlashScan and CLIP
  • Alarm Point: 190°F (88°C) fixed
  • Voltage Range: 15 to 32 VDC peak
  • Standby Current: 200 µA max. average @ 24 VDC
  • Max Current: 4.5 mA @ 24 VDC (LED on)
  • Operating Temperature: -4°F to 150°F (-20°C to 66°C)
  • Spacing: UL 50 ft (15.24 m) center-to-center; FM 25 x 25 ft (7.62 x 7.62 m)
  • Height: 2.0 in (5.3 cm); the base sets the diameter
  • Listings: UL/ULC S747, FM Approved, CSFM 7270-0028:0502

Compatibility

Works with Notifier intelligent bases, including the B300-6-IV flanged base, the B501-IV, and the B224RB-IV relay, B224BI-IV isolator and B200S-IV sounder bases. An optional RA100Z remote LED can be connected.

The VESDA VSP-974 is the genuine replacement rotary valve for Xtralis VESDA-E VEA addressable aspirating smoke detectors. The VEA divides a protected area into individual sampling locations. After a Fire 1 alarm is raised, it uses the rotary valve to scan those locations in sequence and find which ones carry smoke. Service contractors keep this field-replaceable part on hand to restore pinpoint addressability quickly.

Key Features

  • Factory spare part designed specifically for the VESDA-E VEA series
  • Scans the multi-channel microbore sampling tubes in sequence to locate the source of an alarm
  • Also used when an operator starts a manual smoke scan of all locations during Pre-Alarm
  • Field replaceable, which cuts downtime during maintenance
  • Belongs to the same VEA spare-parts family as the VSP-972 filter and VSP-973 pump

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: VESDA by Xtralis (Honeywell)
  • Part Number: VSP-974
  • Description: VESDA-E VEA Rotary Valve
  • Product Type: Aspirating smoke detector spare part
  • Host Detector Supply Voltage: 18 to 30 VDC (VEA detector)

Compatibility

Designed for the VESDA-E VEA detector series, including the VEA-040-A00 (LED fascia) and VEA-040-A10 (3.5" display) models.

The Mircom MIX-M500DMAP is a white intelligent dual-input monitor module that brings two separate initiating device circuits onto an addressable signaling line circuit. It takes two consecutive addresses, and each input is wired Class B (Style B). Use it to monitor normally open (NO) fire alarm and supervisory contacts, such as waterflow and tamper switches, where two nearby points can share one module.

Key Features

  • Two independent 2-wire initiating device circuits (IDCs) at two separate, consecutive addresses
  • Monitors normally open fire alarm and supervisory devices, or normally open or normally closed security devices
  • Rotary address switches
  • Panel-controlled status LED
  • Low standby current
  • Mounts directly in a standard 4-inch square electrical box

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Mircom
  • Part Number: MIX-M500DMAP
  • Color: White
  • Inputs: Two Class B (Style B) IDCs
  • Addresses Used: Two consecutive
  • Average Operating Current: 750 µA (LED flashing); 6.4 mA (LED on)
  • Mounting: 4-inch square electrical box, minimum 2-1/8 in deep
  • Capacity per Panel: Up to 99 modules in CLIP mode; up to 159 modules in AP mode
  • ULC Version: Add suffix "A" (MIX-M500DMAPA)

Compatibility

Connects to the SLC of a compatible Mircom fire alarm control panel running CLIP or AP mode. It is part of the MIX-500 module family with the MIX-M500MAP monitor module, MIX-M501MAP mini monitor and MIX-M502MAP zone interface module.

The Kidde KIR-HD is an intelligent fixed-temperature heat detector from the KIR Series that can also be programmed as a rate-of-rise detector. The detector monitors the surrounding air temperature and analyzes the sensor data to decide when to start an alarm. Kidde recommends it for areas where smoke detection is not appropriate, and for spaces such as laundries and industrial areas where the ambient temperature changes.

Key Features

  • 135°F (57°C) fixed-temperature alarm point
  • Programmable 15°F (8.3°C) per minute rate-of-rise alarm point
  • Continuous self-diagnostics, with results stored in non-volatile memory
  • Convenient rotary addressing and a bicolor (green/red) status LED
  • Up to 250 total devices per loop, using existing wiring
  • Mounts on standard, relay, fault-isolator or audible (sounder) bases

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Kidde
  • Part Number: KIR-HD
  • Fixed-Temperature Rating: 135°F (57°C) UL; 140°F (60°C) ULC
  • Rate-of-Rise Rating: 15°F (8.3°C) per minute (UL)
  • Maximum Spacing: 50 ft (15 m) centers
  • Operating Voltage: 15.2 to 19.95 VDC
  • Current: 51 µA normal; 68 µA alarm (average)
  • Operating Environment: 32 to 120°F (0 to 49°C); 0 to 93% RH non-condensing
  • Wall Mounting: Maximum 12 in (305 mm) from ceiling
  • Standards: Meets UL 521, ULC-S530-M91 and CAN/ULC-S524-01

Compatibility

Compatible with Kidde FX Series intelligent panels. The detector fits the KI-SB/KI-SB4 standard, KI-RB/KI-RB4 relay, KI-IB/KI-IB4 isolator and KI-ABST/KI-ABLT sounder bases. The GSA-LED remote LED can be used with the standard base.

The Napco SLE-ANTEXT100 is the 100-foot kit in the StarLink Omni-X SLE-ANTEX Series of optional universal indoor/outdoor performance antennas. It pairs a white, marine-grade, wide-band omnidirectional antenna with 100' of ultra low-loss premium cable. Installers use it to raise cellular transmission strength and gain mounting flexibility when a communicator sits in a weak-signal area such as a basement or electrical room.

Key Features

  • Universal use with StarLink cellular communicators and with those of other manufacturers
  • Omnidirectional design needs no aiming, and Napco reports excellent 700 MHz LTE performance
  • 100' ultra low-loss premium LMR-type coax, so the antenna can be mounted at the highest practical point
  • Includes an L-bracket with stainless steel U-bolts for poles up to 2 in diameter
  • Includes the SLE-ANTEXT-ISO non-conductive plate, which ground-fault isolates the antenna in commercial fire applications
  • Includes an SMA female to TNC male adapter for use with other brands' communicators

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Napco (StarLink)
  • Part Number: SLE-ANTEXT100
  • Color: White, UV stable
  • Cable: 100' LMR 400 coax, Type N male to SMA male
  • Gain: 4-9 dBi
  • Bandwidth: VSWR <1.5:1, 695-3000 MHz in all 3G and 4G bands
  • Impedance: 50 ohms
  • Max Input Power: 50 W
  • Antenna Dimensions: 8-7/8 in (225 mm) L x 2-3/8 in (60 mm) OD
  • Polarization: Vertical
  • Wind Rating: >110 MPH

Compatibility

Designed for StarLink SLE Fire Series communicators. Napco states it also supports most other cellular radio brands, including Honeywell, Telguard, DSC and DMP.

The Kidde K-RLCD-C is an English-language LCD text annunciator with common controls from the Kidde R-Series of remote annunciators. It repeats system status at a remote location, such as a lobby or entrance, and gives authorized staff panel-level controls there. Contractors specify it where responders need readable event text and control away from the main fire alarm panel.

Key Features

  • Large backlit 4 x 20 character super-twist LCD text display
  • Common controls: Ack/Silence, Reset, Signal Silence, Drill and Lamp Test
  • Status LEDs for Power, Fire Alarm, Supervisory, Ground Fault, Trouble and Controls Enabled, plus an internal buzzer
  • Needs no programming: set the address and the unit receives all its information from the panel
  • Supports up to two K-RLED24 LED expanders and an optional RKEY keyswitch that enables or disables the controls

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Kidde
  • Part Number: K-RLCD-C
  • Language: English
  • Color: Standard (non-red) housing
  • Operating Voltage: 24 VDC
  • Current: 99 mA standby; 115 mA alarm
  • Communications: RS-485, Class A or Class B, 9600 baud; 4,000 ft (1,219 m) maximum wire run
  • Dimensions (H x W x D): 5-5/8 x 8-1/2 x 1-1/2 in (14.3 x 21.4 x 3.8 cm)
  • Mounting: North American 4-inch square electrical box (mounting ring included) or listed enclosure
  • Agency Listing: UL, ULC

Compatibility

Communicates with compatible Kidde fire alarm control panels on the RS-485 data riser. It can be powered by the panel or by an approved power supply. A red version is sold as K-RLCD-CR.

The Eaton EL3RHN-NR is a red Wheelock Eluxa NEMA 3R horn with a 3R mounting plate and no lettering, built for fire alarm signaling indoors or outdoors. It replaces the Wheelock AH-24WP-R. It suits exterior walls, parking structures, canopies and other wet or dusty locations where a standard indoor horn won't hold up.

Key Features

  • Certified to NEMA type 3R and IP54 when used with the included mounting accessory
  • Operates on 12 V or 24 V circuits (DC or FWR)
  • Horn settings CONT, T3 and T3/T4, each with high or low volume
  • Reaches 90 dBA at 10 ft (reverberant, 24 V, high setting)
  • Pre-wire-capable EL3RMP mounting plate with wall or ceiling mounting
  • Rated for -40°F to 150°F, suitable for harsh climates

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Eaton (Wheelock)
  • Part Number: EL3RHN-NR
  • Series: Eluxa outdoor 3R
  • Color / Marking: Red, no lettering
  • Operating Voltage: Regulated 12 V (8-17.5 V) or 24 V (16-33 V), DC or FWR
  • Current @ 24 VDC: 0.052 A high; 0.038 A low
  • Current @ 12 VDC: 0.054 A high; 0.034 A low
  • Sound Output: 90/86 dBA at 24 V; 83/74 dBA at 12 V (high/low, reverberant at 10 ft)
  • Operating Temperature: -40°F to 150°F (-40°C to 66°C), 95% RH
  • Dimensions: 7.8 in L x 5.75 in W x 1.6 in H
  • Wiring: 18 to 12 AWG
  • Standards: UL 464 / CAN/ULC-S525, UL 50/50E, CSFM

The Kidde K-270-SPO is a single-action, non-coded manual pull station from the K-270 Series, with a single-pole, normally open (N/O) contact and screw terminals. Occupants pull the lever to start a fire alarm signal on a conventional initiating circuit. Its rugged die-cast body suits corridors, stairwells and exits in commercial buildings.

Key Features

  • Single-action pull lever with simple, positive operation
  • Break-glass design
  • Pull force under 5 lb, which complies with ADA
  • Solid die-cast metal construction with a streamlined appearance
  • Fire alarm red with aluminum strips, marked "Fire Alarm" on top and "Pull in Case of Fire" on the handle
  • Screw terminals for field wiring

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Kidde
  • Part Number: K-270-SPO
  • Type: Single-action, non-coded, break glass
  • Contacts: Single-pole, normally open (N/O)
  • Contact Rating: 30 VAC / 60 VDC
  • Field Connections: Screw terminals
  • Flush Mounting: 4-inch North American square box with single-gang plaster cover
  • Surface Mounting: Cast box, steel box, or housing for a weatherproof enclosure

Compatibility

For use on conventional initiating device circuits that need a normally open contact. If you need wire leads instead of screw terminals, see the K-270A-SPO. For double-pole contacts, see the K-270-DPO.

VESDA E700-SP-DCL-PIPE labels identify the sampling pipe in VESDA aspirating smoke detection systems. Each roll holds 35 labels that wrap around the pipe. Clear marking tells trades and maintenance staff that the pipe belongs to the life-safety system, so it isn't cut, painted over, blocked or rerouted.

Key Features

  • Sold as a roll of 35 labels
  • Wrap-around style designed to go around the sampling pipe
  • Marks the pipe as part of the VESDA smoke detection system
  • Helps inspectors and technicians trace pipe runs during commissioning and maintenance
  • Xtralis part number for VESDA pipe labeling, listed as the alternative for the older P-LABEL-T pipe label

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: VESDA by Xtralis (Honeywell)
  • Part Number: E700-SP-DCL-PIPE
  • Description: Pipe label for VESDA system, wrap-around
  • Quantity: 35 labels per roll
  • Application: Aspirating smoke detection sampling pipe networks

Compatibility

Suitable for sampling pipe runs on VESDA aspirating smoke detection systems. For marking the sampling holes themselves, Xtralis offers separate sampling point labels, such as the E700-SP-DCL sampling point decal and the E700-SPLR label.

The Siemens SSD-C-REM is a System-Status Display with control for the Cerberus PRO Modular fire alarm system. It mounts on a panel inner door or in a REMBOX remote lobby enclosure. Its LEDs and a four-line LCD repeat the system's local status, and its buttons let authorized staff acknowledge, silence and reset from the remote location.

Key Features

  • Four-line backlit LCD with 40 characters per row shows event type, address, time, custom message and acknowledgment status
  • Separate LEDs for Alarm, Supervisory, Trouble and Security events, plus LEDs for audible circuits active and silenced
  • Three control buttons: acknowledge events, silence audible circuits and reset the system
  • Needs no key switch, because the unit sits inside a locked cabinet
  • Local sounder, with scroll buttons for next and previous events
  • Its bracket holds four inner-door modules, such as the SCM-8 or LCM-8, below the display

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Siemens
  • Part Number: SSD-C-REM (500-634773)
  • Input Voltage: 24 VDC nominal (31 VDC max), filtered
  • Current: 200 mA max at 24 VDC
  • Communication: H-Net from a NIC-C, Class B Style 4 or Class A Style 7
  • Wiring: 12 to 22 gauge screw terminals
  • Mounting: REMBOX2 or REMBOX4 (two module spaces) or any CAB enclosure inner door
  • Series Listings: UL 864 and CAN/ULC-S576 Listed; FM, CSFM and NYCFD Approved

Compatibility

Designed for the Siemens Cerberus PRO Modular system. It takes power from a PSC-12 power supply, a PSX-12 extender, or another UL Listed 24 VDC source.

The Simplex 565-925 is a replacement printed circuit board for Simplex 4098 four-wire duct sensor housings. Technicians use it to repair a duct smoke detection point in an HVAC system without replacing the whole housing. Duct smoke detection lets the fire alarm system sense smoke moving through the air distribution system and start the programmed responses, such as fan shutdown.

Key Features

  • Replacement PC board for Simplex 4098 four-wire duct sensor applications
  • Lets you repair a single failed board without replacing the entire duct housing
  • Genuine Simplex part number, which makes it easy to match service records
  • Suited to service and maintenance contractors who support Simplex duct detection
  • Keeps existing duct housings, sampling tubes and field wiring in place during repair
  • Before ordering, compare the part number printed on the installed board with 565-925

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Simplex (Johnson Controls)
  • Part Number: 565-925
  • Description: 4098 4-Wire Duct Sensor PC Board
  • Wiring Type: 4-wire
  • Product Type: Duct detector replacement part

The Eaton ELSPSTR-AL is a Wheelock Eluxa high-fidelity indoor speaker strobe for wall mounting, with a red housing, a clear lens and ALERT marking. It works on 25 V or 70 V audio circuits and has a selectable LED strobe from 15 to 185 cd. Its ALERT marking fits emergency communications and mass notification systems that deliver voice messages and tones.

Key Features

  • Wide 300 to 8000 Hz frequency response for clear, intelligible voice
  • Six field-selectable wall candela settings: 15, 30, 75, 110, 135 and 185 cd
  • Five field-selectable taps from 1/8 W to 2 W (5 W at 70 V)
  • LED strobe with a low current draw and a 20 ms light pulse, meeting NFPA 72 2016
  • Hinged mounting plate supports pre-wire and pre-test, and finger slide switches change settings with no tools

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Eaton (Wheelock)
  • Part Number: ELSPSTR-AL
  • Series: Eluxa high fidelity
  • Mounting: Wall, indoor
  • Color / Lens / Marking: Red / Clear / ALERT
  • Speaker Voltage: 25 or 70 VRMS
  • Strobe Operation: 24 V
  • Candela: 15/30/75/110/135/185 cd
  • Sound Output: 75 to 87 dBA at 10 ft (UL reverberant, 1/8 W to 2 W)
  • Back Box: ELSPKBB, or 4-inch square, 2-1/8 in deep
  • Wiring: #12 to #18 AWG IN/OUT screw terminals
  • Listings: UL 1971, UL 1638, UL 1480, CAN/ULC-S526, CAN/ULC-S541; CSFM

Compatibility

UL/ULC listed as compatible with fire alarm control panels and accessories that are compatible with Wheelock RSS strobe-based and Exceder LED3 products. Strobes can be synchronized with Wheelock DSM sync modules or PS power supplies.

The System Sensor MP120KL is a 120 VAC adapter mounting plate for L-Series notification appliances. It combines a mounting plate with a built-in power supply that converts 120 VAC to a nominal 24 V FWR. That lets L-Series indoor horns, strobes, horn strobes, chimes and chime strobes run where only line voltage is available.

Key Features

  • Built-in power supply converts 120 VAC to a nominal 24 V FWR
  • Powers a two-wire L-Series horn, strobe, horn strobe, chime or chime strobe
  • Plug-in design eliminates ground faults
  • Works at all horn and strobe settings of the listed compatible models
  • Listed to UL 464 for fire protective signaling systems

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: System Sensor (Honeywell)
  • Part Number: MP120KL
  • Nominal Voltage: Regulated 120 VAC
  • Operating Voltage Range: 96 to 132 VAC
  • Current Draw from AC Line: 150 mA max.
  • Output: Nominal 24 V FWR
  • Operating Temperature: -40°F to 151°F (-40°C to 66°C)
  • Humidity: 10 to 93% non-condensing (indoor products)
  • Indoor Installation: 4 x 4 x 2-1/8 in junction box

Compatibility

For use with L-Series devices only. Compatible models include P2RL, P2WL, P2RL-P, P2WL-P, P2RL-SP, P2WL-SP, PC2RL, PC2WL, SRL, SWL, SRL-P, SWL-P, SRL-SP, SWL-CLR-ALERT, SWL-ALERT, SCRL, SCWL, SCWL-CLR-ALERT, HRL, HWL, CHRL, CHWL, CHSRL, CHSWL, CHSCRL and CHSCWL.

The Edwards SIGA-WTM is a Signature Series combination waterflow/tamper module: one analog addressable device that monitors a sprinkler waterflow switch and a supervisory valve tamper switch. It is UL/ULC listed and has two Class B input circuits for normally open contact devices. Input 1 is used for waterflow alarm and input 2 for supervisory monitoring.

Key Features

  • Two input circuits in one module, for normally open (N.O.) contact devices
  • Waterflow input (personality code 2) needs a contact closure of about 16 seconds before it reports an alarm, and latches the alarm
  • Supervisory input (personality code 4) latches an active event for tamper switches
  • The loop controller assigns two addresses automatically, so there are no address switches
  • Diagnostic LEDs behind the cover: green flashes for normal, red flashes for alarm/active

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Edwards (Kidde / EST)
  • Part Number: SIGA-WTM
  • Operating Voltage: 15.2 to 19.95 VDC
  • Current: 450 µA standby; 700 µA activated
  • Input Circuits: Two Class B (Style B), 47 kΩ EOL (EOL-47)
  • Max Circuit Resistance: 50 Ω per channel (25 Ω per wire)
  • Mounting: 2-1/2 in deep 1-gang box, or 4 in square box 1-1/2 in deep with 1-gang cover
  • Wire Size: 12 to 18 AWG
  • Operating Environment: 32 to 120°F (0 to 49°C); 0 to 93% RH non-condensing
  • Listing: UL/ULC

Compatibility

Requires an Edwards Signature loop controller, which downloads the personality codes. The waterflow input is for non-retarded waterflow switches only. The module does not support conventional 2-wire smoke detectors.

The Eaton Wheelock PS-8-EXP-LP is a POWERPATH 8 amp NAC power supply in a low-profile red cabinet for 120 V service, shipped with the PS-EXP expansion module already installed. It adds notification appliance circuit capacity and auxiliary power to any 12 V or 24 V fire alarm control panel, triggered by a NAC or a dry contact. It is a common choice for ADA strobe upgrades and large NAC loads.

Key Features

  • 8 amps total alarm current
  • With the preinstalled PS-EXP: eight Class B or four Class A notification appliance circuits
  • Each NAC output is 24 VDC, rated up to 3 A, power limited, filtered and regulated
  • Built-in Wheelock synchronization, plus temporal (Code 3), steady or input-follower outputs, and horn silence over two wires
  • 2.5 A auxiliary output with reset capability, and separate AC-loss and common trouble contacts
  • Lockable cabinet holds two 7 AH batteries

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Eaton (Wheelock)
  • Part Number: PS-8-EXP-LP
  • Description: 8 amp power supply with preinstalled expansion module, red enclosure, 120 V
  • Primary Input: 105 to 130 VAC, 50/60 Hz
  • Input Circuits: Two 12 V/24 V NAC (8-33 V at 5 mA) or dry-contact inputs
  • Battery Charging: Up to 32 AH at 0.750 A
  • Cabinet Dimensions: 17 in H x 13 in W x 3.5 in D
  • Listing: UL 864

Compatibility

Compatible with any 12 V or 24 V (FWR or DC) fire alarm control panel through its NAC or dry-contact inputs. Listed for use with 24-volt listed regulated notification appliances.

The Siemens FSD901-U3 is a black LED/LCD remote annunciator for the Cerberus PRO 50-point addressable system. It shows the status of the Model FC901 fire alarm control panel from another location, such as a lobby or security desk. It connects through the panel's built-in RS-485 connection and can include remote system controls.

Key Features

  • LCD shows the same event messages as the main FACP display: 182 characters per screen, 7 lines of 26 characters
  • Navigation keys scroll through the list of panel events
  • LEDs for Power, Alarm, Trouble, Supervisory and Ground Fault, plus audible active and silenced
  • Four control buttons: Acknowledge, Alarm Silence, Unsilence and Reset, protected by a key switch
  • Each annunciator can have its own "Normal" system message
  • Firmware held in flash memory

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Siemens
  • Part Number: FSD901-U3 (S54433-C102-A1)
  • Color: Black
  • Display: 3.5 in x 1.5 in (8.9 x 3.8 cm) LCD
  • Connection: RS-485 to the FC901 main board
  • Mounting: Two-gang electrical box
  • Dimensions: Approx. 8.5 in H x 11.25 in W x 2.5 in D
  • Weight: Approx. 4 lb
  • Environment: Indoor dry locations, 32 to 120°F (0 to 49°C), 93% RH at 90°F
  • Listings: UL 864 10th Edition; FM (#3010), CSFM (#7165-0067:0259), FDNY (#6104) Approved

Compatibility

Designed for the Siemens Cerberus PRO FC901 50-point addressable FACP, which supports up to eight remote annunciators. The unit can be housed in the FTH2073-UA universal enclosure. A red version is sold as FSD901-R3.

The Kidde EG1AVWF is a white Genesis LED EG1 Series compact horn strobe for wall mounting, with FIRE marking and a selectable 15 to 75 cd LED strobe. The Genesis EG1 is about the size of a deck of cards and fits a standard single-gang box. It gives fire alarm audible and visible signaling in offices, classrooms, corridors and other indoor spaces where appearance matters.

Key Features

  • Field-selectable 15, 30 or 75 cd LED strobe output
  • Selectable temporal (T3) or constant horn tone, with high or low output
  • Low profile: protrudes about 1 in from the mounting surface, with no visible mounting screws
  • Can share a circuit and a field of view with legacy xenon strobes
  • Diagnostic test points under the cover allow circuit testing while the device is mounted

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Kidde
  • Part Number: EG1AVWF
  • Color / Marking: White / FIRE
  • Operating Voltage: 16 to 33 VDC or VFWR
  • Candela: 15, 30 or 75 cd
  • Current: 35 mA (low) / 45 mA (high) at 16-33 VDC
  • Sound Output: 85 dBA high / 80 dBA low reverberant (UL 464)
  • Flash Rate: Approx. 1 per second
  • Dimensions (W x H x D): 3 x 4-5/8 x 1-1/8 in
  • Electrical Boxes: 1-gang, 2-gang, 4-inch octagon or 4-inch square (with trim ring), at least 1-1/2 in deep
  • Operating Temperature: 32 to 122°F (0 to 50°C)
  • Listings: UL 1971, UL 1638, UL 464, CSFM

Compatibility

Synchronizes with Kidde CC Series signal modules, booster and auxiliary power supplies, and intelligent and conventional control panels.

The VESDA E700-SPLR is a round, red label for the miniature sampling points of VESDA aspirating smoke detection systems. It identifies each sampling hole on the ceiling so it can be recognized, kept clear and tested during inspections. Ten stickers come on each sheet, ready for installers finishing capillary sampling points in false ceilings.

Key Features

  • Round-style label sized for VESDA miniature sampling points
  • Red color for high visibility on finished ceilings
  • 10 stickers per sheet
  • Marks the sampling point as part of the aspirating smoke detection system
  • Xtralis lists it as the label for the E700-SP capillary sampling point
  • Useful when replacing worn or missing labels during annual inspections

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: VESDA by Xtralis (Honeywell)
  • Part Number: E700-SPLR
  • Style: Round, miniature
  • Color: Red
  • Quantity: 10 stickers per sheet

Compatibility

Used with the VESDA E700-SP sampling point for capillary tube ends. The E700-SP assembly also uses the E700-TA trunk adaptor, the E700-CSC capillary tube connector and E700-CT capillary tubing.

The Notifier NH-200H-IV is an ivory, low-profile intelligent thermal sensor with a fixed 190°F (88°C) alarm point, part of the NH-200 Series built for Notifier FireWarden Series control panels. It supports FlashScan and CLIP protocols and is a direct replacement for the NH-100 Series. Use it to protect property in areas too warm for a 135°F detector.

Key Features

  • High-temperature model factory preset to 190°F (88°C)
  • Thermistor technology for fast response, with built-in device-type identification
  • Rotary decimal switches set the point ID address
  • Two LEDs with 360° visibility: they blink red in normal condition and turn steady red in alarm
  • Magnet-activated functional test, remote test from the panel, and walk test with address display
  • Built-in tamper-resistant feature, with a separate base for easy maintenance

Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Notifier (Honeywell)
  • Part Number: NH-200H-IV
  • Color: Ivory
  • Protocol: FlashScan and CLIP
  • Alarm Point: 190°F (88°C) fixed
  • Voltage Range: 15 to 32 VDC peak
  • Standby Current: 200 µA max. average @ 24 VDC
  • Max Current: 4.5 mA @ 24 VDC
  • Operating Temperature: -4°F to 150°F (-20°C to 66°C)
  • Spacing: UL 50 ft (15.24 m) center-to-center; FM 25 x 25 ft
  • Listings: UL/ULC S747, FM Approved, CSFM 7270-0028:0502

Compatibility

Designed for Notifier FireWarden Series fire alarm control panels. It fits Notifier intelligent bases such as the B300-6-IV flanged base and the B501-IV, along with relay, isolator and sounder bases. An optional RA100Z remote LED annunciator can be connected.

The Notifier 75554 is a laptop-to-NUP-port programming cable used on NOTI-FIRE-NET (NFN) networks. It connects the NFN Web Server to an NCM-W/F network communications module. Choose the NCM-W for twisted-pair wire networks and the NCM-F for fiber-optic cable networks.
